description: Chef-Inspired. Always Delicious. Try out our latest Featured Favorites.

menu.description: NEW Limited-Time Signature Pizza! Inspired by Marvel Television’s Daredevil: Born Again, this fearless pie brings the heat with our classic dough and spicy red sauce as the foundation. It’s stacked with double pepperoni, fresh mozzarella, and fire-roasted red peppers, then finished with a drizzle of Mike’s Hot Honey for a sweet-heat punch that hits fast and lingers strong.

The dough perfectly envelops a melty mix of mozzarella, ricotta, parmesan, oregano, garlic, and savory pepperoni. It is served with 2 side cups of red sauce.
